description: Use when Apex code performs arithmetic on currency, tax, percentage, or quantity values and the result is wrong by a cent, a penny, or a fraction — Decimal scale collapses to 0 after divide, totals don't match the sum-of-line-items, currency-field rounding differs from in-app calculation, or `divide()` throws on a non-existent rounding mode. Triggers: 'apex decimal divide rounded wrong', 'currency calculation off by a penny', 'apex setScale rounding mode', 'integer divided by integer truncated to zero', 'apex Decimal precision lost'. NOT for dated exchange rates — use data/multi-currency-and-advanced-currency-management. NOT for Flow formula rounding — use flow/flow-formula-and-expression-patterns. NOT for SOQL aggregate queries — use apex/apex-aggregate-queries.
inputs: the Apex calculation in question and the expected vs actual result
the field metadata (length, decimal places, currency code) of any SObject fields involved
whether the result is displayed in the UI, written to a currency field, or compared in an equality check
name: apex-decimal-arithmetic-precision
official_sources: Apex Developer Guide — https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/atlas.en-us.apexcode.meta/apexcode/apex_dev_guide.htm — Decimal as an arbitrary precision number whose scale comes from its source (apex dev guide 264 L1224-1246); equal numbers at different scale generally hash differently (L1244-1246).

Apex Reference Guide — https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/atlas.en-us.apexref.meta/apexref/apex_ref_guide.htm — the two `divide` overloads (apexref 262 L212742-212781), `setScale(scale)` half-even (L212707-212709), `valueOf` overloads (L212716-212721), and the eight `System.RoundingMode` values (L212506-212640).

Object Reference (CurrencyType + DatedConversionRate) — https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/atlas.en-us.object_reference.meta/object_reference/sforce_api_objects_concepts.htm — DatedConversionRate exists as an object (object_reference 264 L7778); the multi-currency arithmetic claims in SKILL.md are UNVERIFIED (2026-10-20).
Salesforce Well-Architected Overview — https://architect.salesforce.com/docs/architect/well-architected/guide/overview.html — Reliability and Security pillars framing.
outputs: corrected Apex with explicit `setScale(scale, RoundingMode)` calls and Decimal-typed literals
test data covering the boundary cases (terminating, repeating, half-way, divide-by-zero)
rounding-mode decision aligned with the business rule (banker's rounding for tax, HALF_UP for retail price)
